correctness.rationale: The 16-vertex adjacency definition and face predicate are exact; 65,536 subsets were checked by degree and 160 forbidden wedges. The matching is acyclic by an exhaustive 9,280-incidence directed Hasse DAG check; critical cells 0:1, 3:5, 4:6. The signed integer Morse \(D_4\) is explicitly reconstructed with a unimodular first-five-column minor -1. A simply connected acyclic CW subcomplex built from the first five 4-cells is contractible, leaving \(S^4\); a separately computed original simplicial \(\mathbb F_2\) chain rank supports this. The group \((\mathbb Z/2)^4\rtimes S_5\) is proved to contain and exhaust all 1,920 graph automorphisms; signed Lefschetz traces for each element equal the \(S_5\) sign. Rational quotient homology follows via invariants after subdivision. Complete proof and stdout from actual included Python source are supplied; no infinite-family extrapolation.

value.rationale: The Clebsch folded five-cube is a canonical strongly regular and distance-transitive graph; parameter two gives its first higher-independence (forbidden-wedge) complex. Establishing \(S^4\) despite nonpure faces through dimension seven and determining its full integral orientation character reveals a structural boundary unavailable from ordinary independence, Lovász neighborhood or edge matching computations. The sign quotient consequence gives a natural meaningful invariant rather than a routine numerical table or arbitrary slice.
